cards.verse_text: So all the men and women of the Israelites whose hearts prompted them brought a freewill offering to the LORD for all the work that the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.

cards.card_text: How often do the people keep bringing freewill offerings for the sanctuary?
cards.verse_text: Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,
cards.snippet: Meanwhile, the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning,

cards.card_text: The thanksgiving meat must be eaten the day it's offered, a vow or a freewill offering may be finished the next day, and anything left on the third day must be burned up.
cards.verse_text: If, however, the sacrifice he offers is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice, but the remainder may be eaten on the next day.
cards.snippet: If, however, the sacrifice he offers is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day he presents his sacrifice,…

cards.card_text: It's about any man of Israel, or any foreign resident, who brings a burnt offering to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to Aaron and his sons and all the Israelites and tell them, ‘Any man of the house of Israel or any foreign resident who presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,
cards.snippet: …offering to the LORD, whether to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

cards.card_text: Then He turns to the peace offering, brought from the herd or flock for a vow or as a freewill offering.
cards.verse_text: When a man presents a peace offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without blemish or defect to be acceptable.
cards.snippet: …from the herd or flock to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without blemish or defect to be acceptable.

cards.card_text: There's one exception: an ox or sheep with a deformed or stunted limb may be a freewill offering, but not for a vow.
cards.verse_text: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb, but it is not acceptable in fulfillment of a vow.
cards.snippet: You may present as a freewill offering an ox or sheep that has a deformed or stunted limb,…

cards.card_text: And all of that comes on top of the Sabbath offerings, the gifts, the vow offerings and the freewill offerings.
cards.verse_text: These offerings are in addition to the offerings for the LORD’s Sabbaths, and in addition to your gifts, to all your vow offerings, and to all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.
cards.snippet: …to your gifts, to all your vow offerings, and to all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.

cards.card_text: Then He lays out what comes with an animal offering from the herd or flock, whether for a vow, a freewill offering or an appointed feast: fine flour mixed with olive oil, plus wine as a drink offering.
cards.verse_text: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: After you enter the land that I am giving you as a home and you present a food offering to the LORD from the herd or flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD—either a burnt offering or a sacrifice, for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast— then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.
cards.snippet: …LORD—either a burnt offering or a sacrifice, for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast— then the one presenting his offering to the…

cards.card_text: Their vow and freewill offerings Their guilt and ordination offerings Their wave and heave offerings
cards.verse_text: You are to present these offerings to the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.”
cards.snippet: …the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.”

cards.card_text: That place is where it all comes: burnt offerings, sacrifices, tithes, heave offerings, vow offerings, freewill offerings, and the firstborn of the herds and flocks.
cards.verse_text: To that place you are to bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and heave offerings, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, as well as the firstborn of your herds and flocks.
cards.snippet: …offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and heave offerings, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, as well as the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

cards.card_text: At the Feast of Weeks, Israel brings a freewill offering.
cards.verse_text: And you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God has blessed you,
cards.snippet: …celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a freewill offering that you give in proportion to how the LORD your God…

cards.card_text: Kore, the Levite who keeps the East Gate, is in charge of the freewill offerings.
cards.verse_text: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, the keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions to the LORD and the consecrated gifts.
cards.snippet: …Levite, the keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions to the LORD and the…

cards.card_text: And their neighbors come THROUGH with silver and gold, goods and livestock, and valuables, on top of all the freewill offerings.
cards.verse_text: And all their neighbors supported them with articles of silver and gold, with goods and livestock, and with valuables, in addition to all their freewill offerings.
cards.snippet: …with goods and livestock, and with valuables, in addition to all their freewill offerings.

cards.card_text: When the returned exiles reach the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, who gives freewill offerings for it?
cards.verse_text: When they arrived at the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site.
cards.snippet: …the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site.

cards.card_text: Those family heads give their freewill offerings so the house of God can be rebuilt on a brand-new site.
cards.verse_text: When they arrived at the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site.
cards.snippet: …the LORD in Jerusalem, some of the heads of the families gave freewill offerings to rebuild the house of God on its original site.

cards.card_text: After that, the altar gets a FULL schedule: the regular burnt offerings, the New Moons, all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, plus every freewill offering people bring.
cards.verse_text: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings and those for New Moons and for all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as all the freewill offerings brought to the LORD.
cards.snippet: …the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as all the freewill offerings brought to the LORD.

cards.card_text: Ezra is to take silver and gold the king and his counselors FREELY offered to the God of Israel, plus silver and gold from the province of Babylon and freewill offerings from the people and priests.
cards.verse_text: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem, together with all the silver and gold you may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God in Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: …may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God…

cards.card_text: Then he asks the LORD to accept the freewill offerings of his mouth.
cards.verse_text: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
cards.snippet: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.

cards.card_text: Now say the prince brings a freewill offering to the LORD, a burnt offering or a peace offering.
cards.verse_text: When the prince makes a freewill offering to the LORD, whether a burnt offering or a peace offering, the gate facing east must be opened for him.
cards.snippet: When the prince makes a freewill offering to the LORD, whether a burnt offering or a peace offering,…

cards.card_text: For the prince's freewill offering, the gate facing east is opened for him.
cards.verse_text: When the prince makes a freewill offering to the LORD, whether a burnt offering or a peace offering, the gate facing east must be opened for him.

cards.card_text: Along with leavened bread as a thank offering, the LORD tells Israel to keep their freewill offerings quiet.
cards.verse_text: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings.
cards.snippet: Offer leavened bread as a thank offering, and loudly proclaim your freewill offerings.
